item_name: Rothco Tactical Breakaway First Aid Kit
item_short_desc: Be prepared for emergencies with Rothco's Tactical Breakaway First Aid Kit. Designed for rapid access, the tri-fold pouch detaches easily from the main loop platform, giving you immediate reach to essential supplies. MOLLE-compatible straps allow seamless attachment to tactical vests, backpacks, or other gear. The kit features durable polyester construction and a versatile design with interior elastic loops, zippered pockets, and open compartments to organize over 20 bandages, cold packs, alcohol prep pads, and more.
description: Be prepared for emergencies with Rothco's Tactical Breakaway First Aid Kit. Designed for rapid access, the tri-fold pouch detaches easily from the main loop platform, giving you immediate reach to essential supplies. MOLLE-compatible straps allow seamless attachment to tactical vests, backpacks, or other gear. The kit features durable polyester construction and a versatile design with interior elastic loops, zippered pockets, and open compartments to organize over 20 bandages, cold packs, alcohol prep pads, and more. A double-zippered closure ensures secure storage, while the loop field on the front allows for easy name or patch attachment. Complete with a top carry handle and multiple pockets, this first aid kit is a must-have for first responders, outdoor enthusiasts, or anyone needing reliable emergency preparedness.
